name: input-group
description: Combines an input or textarea with inline and block addons.

files.content: {@render children?.()}

<script module lang="ts">
import type { InputProps } from "../input/input.svelte";

export type InputGroupInputProps = InputProps;
</script>

<script lang="ts">
import type { Component } from "svelte";
import InputComponent from "../input/input.svelte";

const Input = InputComponent as Component<InputGroupInputProps, object, "ref" | "value">;

let {
  class: className,
  ref = $bindable(null),
  value = $bindable(),
  ...props
}: InputGroupInputProps = $props();
</script>

{#if className === undefined}
  <Input bind:ref bind:value unstyled {...props} />
{:else}
  <Input bind:ref bind:value unstyled class={className} {...props} />
{/if}

<script module lang="ts">

export type InputGroupTextareaProps = TextareaProps;
</script>

<script lang="ts">

  ref = $bindable(null),
  value = $bindable(),
  ...props
}: InputGroupTextareaProps = $props();
</script>

{#if className === undefined}
  <Textarea bind:ref bind:value unstyled {...props} />
{:else}
  <Textarea bind:ref bind:value unstyled class={className} {...props} />
